metadata.description: CyberRiskGuardian Community Edition: free plugins for scenario-driven cybersecurity risk assessment and the cybersecurity governance textbook.

plugins.name: cyberriskguardian
plugins.description: CyberRiskGuardian Core (Community Edition, free) - scenario-driven cybersecurity risk assessment, steps 1-11 of the 19-step CRG method: context and evidence intake, risk appetite, scenario generation (25-40 candidates, never fewer than 20), screening and selection, validated CRG quantification with CVSS v4.0, and a management summary, with methodology label checks.

plugins.name: crg-governance-textbook
plugins.description: The textbook Introduction to Cybersecurity Governance for Business Technology Management (Léger, 3rd ed., v2.51, October 2026; 21 chapters, CRG appendix and answer key) as a reference skill: governance, risk, compliance and resilience concepts with chapter citations.
